correctness.rationale: Odd symbol parity proves primitive circular iterates, so all sorted rotations are distinct. A parity analysis of length-three factors forces long bispecial factors to be exactly substitutions mu(v)0 of shorter bispecials, providing a complete induction. Lexicographic reversal among even-start substituted rotations transfers each BWT predecessor cut. The empty cut contributes none, 00 always contributes, and 0 contributes from rank three onward, yielding exactly 2k−3 explicitly classified cuts and 2k−2 runs. The actual checker independently reproduced sorted rotations through rank 9, complete bispecial sets through rank 7, and boundary-prefix sets through rank 14; the unrestricted proof is given separately.
